notes.title: Major Update version 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the game has been updated to version 1.2. Here are the main updates:

1 New Dream Region Unlocked: The Brave Dream
Contains 40 new scenes divided into two major areas: Dune Sea and Sea of Fear.
After completing the Ardent Dream, switch regions at the Dream Catcher in your base.
Then you can access via the northern and southern exits of the base.

2 New Content in The Brave Dream
(1) New instance: The Temple Ruin,
(2) Over 60 new creatures and enemies
(3) 200+ new items, collectibles, and craftables 

3 New Features & Upgrades
(1) Level 4 Altar unlocked. Two new tech options: Cheese Making and Cuisine (boosts attribute growth). Level 3 and Level 4 Combat Magic unlocked.
(2) New equipment slots unlocked via related technologies.
(3) New Buildables: Assembly Table, Milk Fountain, Cheese Churn
(4) New Achievements Added

4 Optimizations: UI improvements, Game balance adjustments, Miscellaneous updates

Let me know if you need clarification on specific features! 😊

notes.title: Small update 0304
notes.content:
1 In preparation for upcoming large update, I have begun some modifications on the combat system. 
Now the parry mechanism has been changed: parrying now deducts a fixed amount of energy at the start, and after the enemy land an attack, additional energy will be deducted based on the difference between the enemy's attack power and the player's strength. 
If the energy deduction is successful, the parry succeeds, if it fails, the player will be knocked down.
Correspondingly, some enemy attacks will no longer have stun effects, instead impose some energy drain. For instance, the Boss Sloth's combo attacks will no longer stun players, players can now parry and interrupt its combo. More changes are still under development and not yet implemented.
ps: if you feel bad about this update, please let me know by post your valuable feedback on community
2 The pond in the base can now be used to plant water chestnut plants and lotus plants. Once planted, they can be harvested repeatedly.
3 Now you can see the buff and debuff on the enemies
4 Some UI elements have been optimized with visual enhancements.

notes.title: Game Update Roadmap 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it has been three weeks since the game was released. Thank you all for your attention and support. Moving forward, the game will continue to be updated as planned. I should present a fancy roadmap picture here, but firstly, I don't have the time, and secondly, there isn't much content worthy of being illustrated. Therefore, I will simply present the plan in text as follows:

1.The addition of the Fourth Dream, the Brave Dream, and our character will complete the entire storyline.
I do not want to create a game that could be played repeatedly, endlessly farming and living day to day. I hope it can be a journey to be completed, a story to be told, and once finished, there is no need to look back. The fourth dream area and the final area's game content are expected to take players approximately 4-8 hours to complete. Including the previous three areas, I hope the entire game can be concluded within 30-50 hours.
This part of the work will be done within three months, meaning the update will be released by May 2025.

2.After completing the first task, I also hope to make some adaptive adjustments to the game within two months, i.e., by July 2025, including: controller support, more language localization support, etc.
Due to the extensive interaction with building UIs within the game, achieving effective controller adaptation is challenging, hence I have to leave it to the end to complete. My apologies for this!

Additionally, for any issues discovered and suggestions made regarding the game, I welcome your timely feedback. I will make adjustments at any time, and this does not conflict with the overall update plan.

Still within the Chinese New Year, I once again extend my New Year greetings to everyone and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Summary of major update contents since release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, based on all the feedback, the game has made more than 20 updates since release. The main features updated are listed below for your reference:
1. Provided custom key binding
2. Provided autosave and steam cloud save
3. Provided the ability to reset dream region after defeating the region boss
4. Provided difficulty change options within the game. And made the easy difficulty level easier
5. Enhancements have been made to the game UI, in-game information guidance, and some building operations UI
6. Added some items, Buff and crops
7. Minor adjustments to some game contents to improve gameplay, such as increasing the number of item stacks, etc.
The detailed information about updates can be referred to the update records on the community forum. The game will continue to be updated, and a brief update roadmap will be released in next week. 
Thank you for your support, and welcome for more valuable feedback.
